items.title: AI Euphoria Gives Way to Fear And ‘Face-Ripping Volatility’
items.summary: All year, investors have gorged themselves on whatever the AI trade served up. Hundreds of billions of dollars of stock sold to build out infrastructure. Near-daily bond offerings to pay for chips and data centers. History’s two largest IPOs.
